description: We are a group of aspiring engineers, dedicated to gaining knowledge and experience in both hardware and software. We possess several skills, including but not limited to: Programming in multiple languages, electronics, 3D CAD Design, 3D Printing, Web, Game and UI Development, and Data Visualisation/Management.
summary: A project allowing us to help our astronauts in space mitigate the health effects of muscle atrophy and measure its degree over long periods of time.
details: Our heroes in space suffer greatly when they return to earth due to muscle atrophy. They can mitigate the effects by proper training and diet. To be able to mitigate the drawbacks we must have systems that actively prevent and measure this event. Our project utilizes a constant pressure baseline to measure the change in the peak pressure measurements over long periods of time and graph the decrease in muscle mass, showing a clear correlation with muscle atrophy. This would allow us to actively change their training programs so they can return to normal life quickly.
